messages:
pat: FYI planning a short rolling maintenance in az2 to address intermittent netstack packet drops and to apply a small kernel NIC patch. Window: Sat 2026-04-18 23:00-01:00 UTC. Expect soft drains and 2-4min NIC resets per host.

maya: Which pools are targeted? Any reserved capacity in az2?

pat: Target: az2-edge-burst and az2-spot-slice. Reserved/Dedicated racks are excluded. If we see spillover, we'll route to az1-regional-pool.

eli: Past cold-cache spikiness hurt p99. Mitigation: run kvseed to warm prefix cache 45m before start and set continuous-batching fallback.

sam: I'll run kvseed and cap autoscaler maxSurge to 12%. Do NOT fully suspend autoscaling.

ops-bot: Created ticket: MO-2478 https://redwood.atlassian/issue/MO-2478

netops-bot: BGP pref change ready: az1 will be preferred during the window. Will apply at T-5m.

maya: Canary plan: 4 hosts in eu-central at T-30m. Abort if packet-drop > 0.15% or p95 latency > 120ms.

eli: Rollout timeline:
- 22:15 pre-seed kv on standbys
- 22:30 start eu-central canary (4 hosts)
- 22:50 validate + 10m buffer
- 23:00 start az2 racks in 6-min stagger cohorts
- 00:50 final check
- 01:00 close window
Who is oncall?

pat: Oncall: maya, eli. Sam will lead the runbook. Finance: minimal expected hosted token delta, @finance-bot to confirm.

sam: Preflight commands:
```bash
python infra/kvseed.py --pool az2-edge-burst --seed 0.75 --timeout 2700
kubectl patch hpa cluster-autoscaler -p '{"spec":{"maxSurge":0.12}}'
```

maya: Rollback short playbook: if p99 latency delta > 0.5% or packet drops > threshold -> pause rollout, re-inject nodes, route to az1, escalate to infra oncall.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: MO-2478 will start Sat 2026-04-18 23:00 UTC. Canary automation at T-30m.

pat: I'll post customer advisory targeted to burst pool owners and lock the autoscaler cap at T-20m. :thumbsup:
